categories.name: Economics specialization electives (Wahl 1)
categories.note: Two 6-ECTS modules from specializations 1 to 5 (the same specialization may be chosen twice); eCampus lists each specialization as one 12-ECTS module

summary: PO of 20.04.2022 (Berufspädagogik/Wirtschaftspädagogik bachelor): 81 ECTS compulsory economics and business education modules, Wahl 1 (two 6-ECTS modules from the five specializations) and Wahl 2 (one 6-ECTS module from Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftspolitik, Wirtschaftsprivatrecht, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Methoden or Verhaltensökonomische Grundlagen), plus the minor subject and education studies.
